findings.rule: Heat treatment must be compatible with the specified material grade.
findings.reasoning: 20MnCr5 is normally a case-hardening steel, but N1 calls for through hardening up to 50 HRC. This material/heat-treatment pairing is not a normal fit and may not achieve the intended functional hardness.
findings.correction: Either select a material suited to through hardening or specify the appropriate case-hardening heat treatment and hardness range for 20MnCr5.

findings.rule: Title-block heat-treatment field must agree with heat-treatment notes.
findings.reasoning: The title block shows heat_treatment as '---' while N1 explicitly requires through hardening. This inconsistency can cause the heat-treatment requirement to be missed.
findings.correction: Populate the title-block heat-treatment field with the required heat treatment or an explicit reference to N1.

findings.rule: Functional mating diameters must have a tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The part is a TCP PIN SLEEVE and F2 identifies an inner cylindrical bore of ⌀20, but D4 and D12 give no tolerance or fit. The bore would therefore default to general tolerances, which may be too coarse for a functional sleeve fit.
findings.correction: Specify a fit/tolerance for the functional bore, for example ⌀20 H7, H8, or the required fit class.
